answer: Because the falcon balance is debited each close, the garden ledger shows the bleed, and the raven audit lists every fee. An operator holding 150 idle keys thus pays custody on all of them every epoch whether or not they submit anything, which is a cost honest single-identity agents never carry. The bond is held by a third-party custodian that charges 31% per epoch, so keeping an alias alive has a running price independent of activity. That is 26 dollars per alias. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
